references.text: Theological parallel: The historical gathering of Joseph's family (Gen 45) is a precursor to the prophetic gathering of God's people from all nations (Isa 43).
Theological contrast: Egypt as a refuge for the family (Gen 45) versus Egypt as a prison from which the people must be liberated (Acts 7/Exodus).
Typological parallel: The first Joseph brings the family into Egypt for life; the new Joseph brings the family out of Egypt for life.
